question: Does Speciality pay companies owned by its promoters?
stopped_by: the model wrote no tool call
answer:
**Yes, Speciality reports expenses involving related entities**, though the filing describes the connection as *significant influence*, not necessarily ownership.

In FY26, it reported rent expenses involving Situations Advertising & Marketing Services, Havik Exports LLP and Prosperous Promotors LLP. It also reported retainership fees and advertising expenses involving Situations. The filing classifies these as entities in which key management personnel or their relatives can exercise significant influence. [FY26 annual report, PDF pp. 173–174]

The report says the related-party transactions were in the ordinary course of business and at arm’s length. It says none was material. [FY26 annual report, PDF p. 50]
expected: Yes. FY26 rent: Situations Advertising & Marketing Services ₹495.53 lakh (FY25 ₹449.40 lakh), Prosperous Promotors ₹70.80 lakh, Havik Exports ₹45.39 lakh, Anjan Chatterjee HUF ₹22.77 lakh. Also to Situations: advertising ₹33.45 lakh and reimbursements ₹120.48 lakh
